title: Contact Us
seo_title: Contact Us: Help Choosing the Right Dog Bed | PawLunova
seo_description: Unsure on size, or whether a bed suits a stiff older dog? Contact PawLunova with their breed and weight and we'll tell you honestly which one fits. Ask us.
body_html:
Contact PawLunova before you buy, not just after. If you're stood in the hallway with a tape measure, wondering whether your dog is a Medium or a Large, that's the moment to ask. Send us their breed and weight and we'll tell you honestly which size fits.

How to contact PawLunova, and what to include

A few details get you a precise answer rather than a general one:

  • Choosing a bed: breed, weight and how they sleep (curled up, leaning on something, or stretched flat out).
  • Crate or boot beds: the inside measurements of the crate base or boot floor.
  • Outdoor dog houses and day beds: ask for the exact dimensions before you order.
  • An order, or a return under the 100-night trial: your order number.

Some answers are already written down: measuring in the size guide, washing and delivery in our FAQ, and, if you'd like one bed suggested from four questions, the Bed Finder.

For everything else, use the form on this page. Tell us about your dog and we'll give you a straight answer.
